additional_metadata.precision: BF16 weights and autocast, FP32 token pooling; Python float aggregation and sigmoid
additional_metadata.long_text_handling: service paragraph/sentence chunks <=512; content-token weighted mean logit; sigmoid
additional_metadata.training_disclosure: Multilingual fine-tuning lineage through danibor/oculus-v2.0-multilingual and desklib/ai-text-detector-v1.01. RAID official train samples were used for English replay. No RAID hidden test labels were accessed or used for checkpoint selection. Upstream pretraining and fine-tuning overlap cannot be fully audited.
additional_metadata.selection: Checkpoint fixed before RAID scoring from existing multilingual development evidence; no RAID score-based selection.
additional_metadata.coverage: All 672000 official test rows, including adversarial variants; no truncation to first 512 tokens.
additional_metadata.probability_note: Scores are sigmoid of weighted mean model logits, not empirically calibrated posterior probabilities.
additional_metadata.sharding: Two disjoint contiguous halves, separate SQLite stores, all IDs checked on merge

performance_revision.changes: Exact-shape CUDA graphs after8 occurrences, cache constant relative positions, NumPy padding. Same model, BF16, batch geometry, tokens, aggregation and DB resume signatures.

graph_cache_revision.policy: At most four graph shapes, <=256 tokens; LFU replacement. Avoid low-benefit large graph private pools.
